summary: Full backend + frontend testing for PT. Jawa Dwipa Solutions travel rental app. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases passed (auth, RBAC, orders CRUD w/ compute+validation, multi-drivers, master CRUD w/ tipe auto-derive, analytics x4, xlsx exports x4, user mgmt). Frontend: login renders, session-cookie injection works, all 7 protected routes load (dashboard, 3 analyses, transaksi, master, pengguna), KPIs populate (Rp 747M omset, 299 orders, 14 units), search + date filters trigger, 3-step wizard successfully creates an order with live margin calc (Rp 2.450.000 shown correctly), master tabs switchable, Users mgmt page shows role selects + active switches for all 3 users.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description (a11y warning in console). Non-blocking.
Page <title> is default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' instead of Jawa Dwipa branding.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add DialogDescription to Order wizard dialog to remove Radix a11y warning.
(Nice-to-have) Update <title> in frontend/public/index.html to product branding.
critical_code_review_comments: gen_order_code uses db.orders.count_documents + prefix — not race-safe and can collide after deletes; consider a per-prefix counter or unique index on id_order.
Login page has hardcoded background image URL from unsplash; consider self-hosting for reliability.
clean() only strips _id from a single dict; list responses (e.g., /orders, /clients) rely on {'_id':0} projection everywhere — currently OK but easy to forget.
No pagination on list endpoints (to_list(5000/10000)); will need pagination past that volume.
Backend Pydantic model accepts more than 4 drivers; the 'max 4' rule is only enforced client-side. Consider adding server-side validator len(drivers) <= 4.
Analytics endpoints re-fetch all orders per call with no caching/index on tanggal_mulai; add index for growth.
